phase: Confirmed review fixes implemented; source-matched local suites passed
publicationRule: Implemented playable entries are linked in the catalog; source-matched verification is tracked independently in coverage/index.json. Planned inventory is not playable.
liveCommitMeaning: The nested historicalRelease identifies the previously verified publication; it is not proof for current changed source.

historicalRelease.localVerificationNote: All100 current games completed desktop/mobile. Independent ordinary-play review sampled19games and all resulting fixes were retested.

verificationPolicy: Current local claims are generated only from successful source-content-matched suite runs in coverage/index.json. Live route/reset smoke, solver completion, touch-only completion and ordinary-play reviews are separate scopes.

currentLiveVerification.policy: A successful run matching the published commit is required. Consult that run for deployed byte matching, 200 route/viewport smoke checks and reviewed-issue Chromium/WebKit regressions. A push alone is not verification.

currentLocalVerification.scope: Current successful suite runs only; source content hashes exclude generated coverage and documentation. Mobile viewport completion is not touch-only completion or iPhone/Safari certification. Solvers may inspect hidden answers and use virtual time. Competitive strategy terminal results can be losses. Live route/reset checks and ordinary-play samples are separate.
